show.description: Heartbroken after a humiliating divorce from Rahul Mishra, simple yet talented chef Khushi Mehra hides a powerful secret, she is heir to one of India’s richest families. When ruthless business tycoon Aryan Singhania enters her life with a contract marriage, Khushi faces betrayal, corporate rivalries, and shocking family feuds. In a journey of love, revenge, and self-discovery, she proves she can shine brightest rich without him. Watch Now!
